overloads.semanticRole: PREVIOUS RECORD moves the current record pointer to the previous record in the current selection of aTable for the current process.

constraints: No effect if the current selection is empty, or if the record pointer is already before/at end of selection (Before selection or End selection is True).
If moving before the current selection, End selection returns True and there is no current record; use FIRST RECORD, LAST RECORD or GOTO SELECTED RECORD to move back into the selection.
